reasoning: This gazette content is an Order under Section 4 of the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No. 9 of 1996, which declares that the provisions of the Act shall apply to the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees. It contains detailed legal provisions, privileges, and immunities related to the agreement between UNHCR and the Sri Lankan government. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments, legal frameworks, and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
